device.not_connected: The sensor is not connected. Try again in a moment.
device.bluetooth_proxy_on: The BLE proxy is on. Homey does not use it and it makes the connection unstable. Turn off “BLE | Proxy” on the sensor's web page.

manual.title: Add by IP address
manual.intro: No Sensy S1 Pro was found automatically. This happens when the sensor is on another network or your router blocks discovery. Enter its address to add it anyway.
manual.hint: You find the address in your router, or on the sensor as “ESP32 | IP”. A fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) is recommended.
manual.invalid_address: That is not a valid IP address or host name.
manual.not_reachable: No sensor answered at this address. Check the address and that the sensor is powered on.
manual.unsupported: This device is not a Sensy-One S1 Pro Multi Sense.
manual.already_added: This sensor is already added to Homey.
